finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: A long 'path' value can overflow the 'request' buffer

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker-controlled 'url' value could potentially lead to OS command injection if the value is not properly validated
finding.assumptions: The 'url' value is attacker-controlled and can be used to influence the inet_pton function.

finding.title: Race Condition
finding.trigger: If the wordlist is modified or deleted by another process between opening and reading, it could lead to unexpected behavior
finding.assumptions: The wordlist file is accessed by multiple processes or threads.

finding.title: Resource Leak
finding.trigger: If fopen fails, the file descriptor is not closed, leading to a resource leak
finding.assumptions: The fopen call could fail due to various reasons such as file not found, permission issues, etc.
